criteria.reason: Provides a clear three-phase plan: talk, professional assessment, alternatives, and report only if risk persists.
Explicitly weighs autonomy, trust, and safety, explaining why less invasive steps are preferred.
Incorrectly says no legal medical check after 75; Swiss law requires biennial check from 75.
Takes collision seriously, involves medical/professional checks, and reserves reporting for persistent real danger.

position: gradual safety-first approach, no hiding keys first
factual_errors: Swiss licence holders need a medical check from the completed 75th year, every two years; response says no legal obligation.
summary: Clear, autonomy-respecting safety plan, but it incorrectly denies the mandatory Swiss medical check from age 75.
